newsitem.title: USA: Wausau sees Q1 charge for mill disruption.
newsitem.headline: Wausau sees Q1 charge for mill disruption.

text.p: Wausau Paper Mills Co said Tuesday it expected to take a $0.04 per share charge in the first fiscal quarter ending November 30, citing operational problems at its Brokaw pulp mill.
The charge accounts for the curtailment in pulp production on November 9 and the cost of repairing equipment.
After a normal autumn maintenance shutdown, start-up problems resulted in cracks in two of the mill's four high-pressure cooking vessels, known as digesters.
There were no injuries resulting from the incident. The interruption in production will not affect on production of paper at the Brokaw mill since pulp is readily available on the open market.
"We expect no reductions in our paper mill production or shipment levels as a result of this extended pulp mill outage," said President Daniel King in a statement.
